channel.title: Livable Telluride — Weekly Digest
channel.description: This week's upcoming Gov-Hub meetings and community events across the Telluride region (Town of Telluride, Mountain Village, San Miguel County, the Sheridan Opera House, The Alibi, Wilkinson Library, KOTO, telluride.com, and more).

item.title: 📅 The Week Ahead — Nov 25–1
item.description: Thanksgiving is the main event this week — the Turkey Trot kicks off Thursday morning, Alloy Kitchen is hosting an Outlaw Thanksgiving, and there's live music at Mountain Lodge if you need somewhere to land. The library has a movie matinee and Radio Biblioteca on Wednesday for folks easing into the holiday, and the weekend stretches out with Will Ski 4 Food, free open skate, and Mind Blown for those sticking around after the feast.

item.title: [Thu, Nov 26] Turkey Trot 2026
item.description: 🎫 KOTO Dust off those tennis shoes and tail feathers – the Turkey Trot is back! This 5K walk/run is free and fun for the whole family (even Fido!). Sign up online in advance to be entered into a raffle, with additional prizes for the fastest male, fastest female, fastest kid under 12 and best costume. The event will take place at the intersection of Sunshine Mesa Rd. and Ilium Rd. at 9:00 a.m. on Thanksgiving morning, Thursday, November 26th, at 9:00 a.m. Sign up online at bit.ly/smcturkeytrot2026.

item.description: 🎫 KOTO 📍 Lone Cone Library Norwood We are a MOBILE family business offering non-competitive Gymnastics, Preschool Spanish, & Dance classes to the San Miguel County area. Tia Uphoff was a competitive gymnast and an instructor for 20+ years, helping children develop balance, flexibility, strength and proper tumbling techniques while using positive reinforcement and encouragement for success. Infant to Age 5 — Padres & Pequenos Class – $10.00 per class This class invites adults & kids to participate in Educational songs, in English & Spanish, with intro to gymnastics. Sign up at any time and get started weekly. Fridays — 11:15-11:40 am @ Lone Cone Library Norwood K to 3rd Grade week Session 8 Week Winter Session $150 for the 8 sessions. Thursdays – 430-530 pm @ Lone Cone Library Norwood For more information and to register: Contact Tia @ liv2danz247@gmail.com or find us on Facebook!

item.description: 🎫 KOTO 📍 Mountain Lodge Telluride, Mountain Village Mind Blown Telluride is the Number 1 show in Telluride, Colorado. It is a "Must See!" item.title: [Sat, Nov 28] Yoga with Lauren
item.description: 🎫 KOTO 📍 Wilkinson Public Library, Telluride Move, breathe, and energize in this dynamic bilingual class, led by Lauren Norton, designed to uplift your body and mind! Blending the strength and flow of Pilates, the rhythm and energy of dance, and the grounding presence of yoga and breathwork, this session will leave you feeling strong, balanced, and revitalized. Open to all levels, this fun and fast-paced class welcomes everyone looking to build strength, flexibility, and mindfulness in a supportive community space. This class is free, but donations for the instructor are welcome. item.title: [Sun, Nov 29] Will Ski 4 Food
item.description:
🎫 KOTO 📍 Sheridan Opera House, Telluride
Will Ski 4 Food – a film following longtime Warren Miller cameraman, Gary Nate and the pioneers of freestyle skiing – is coming to the Sheridan Opera House for two screenings on Saturday, November 28 th , at 5:30 & 8 p.m. Gary spent part of his career filming in Telluride, including memorable segments featuring Scott Kennett and his dog, Zudnik. Tickets are available at sheridanoperahouse.com.

item.title: [Mon, Nov 30] The Real Book Club-Jazz Standards
item.description:
🎫 KOTO 📍 Wilkinson Public Library, Telluride
Join us for The Real Book Club, a monthly jazz jam session for musicians of all levels who want to dive into classic jazz standards together! Whether you're a seasoned improviser or just starting out, this is a welcoming space to play, practice, and connect with fellow jazz enthusiasts. Each month, we’ll focus on three jazz standards selected from The Real Book. You’ll receive PDFs of the tunes in advance so you can shed at home and come ready to jam. Lead sheets will also be available on the day of the event. The songs we will play at this jam are: Once I Loved by Antonio Carlos Jobim. Here is a version I quite like with Astrud Gilberto singing. Guantanamera by Jose Fernandez Diaz. Here is a version I quite like by Joseito Fernandez. …

item.title: [Mon, Nov 30] Desserts and Docs-The Colorado Experience
item.description:
🎫 KOTO 📍 Wilkinson Public Library, Telluride
Join us for this 4 part series as we watch episodes from RMPBS Flagship history series, explores the people, places. and events that has shaped Colorado's rich heritage. August: "The Original Coloradans" An incredible look at the Ute Nation, their history before colonization, and their interactions with early trappers. September: " October: November: "The Games That Never Happened". The fascinating modern-history story of how Denver became the only city in the world to win the Winter Olympics and then vote to give them back!
